title: External Affairs Officer
description:
External Affairs Officer (Holyrood)

Scotland £46.1k - £48.4k (dependant on experience with clear salary progression)

Full-time Hybrid

Joint-contribution pension from 6% (12% total) - Enhanced maternity & family leave - Life assurance - HolidayPlus - Virtual GP & Employee Assistance Programme plus retail and leisure discounts & many more.

REQ5824

We are looking for an External Affairs Officer to be the core link between SGN and our political engagement in Holyrood and the Scottish Government. You will be key to fostering a positive relationship with relevant political figures and deliver engagement plans to sustain positive relationships. You will closely monitor parliamentary activity and ensure SGN are positioned with a consistent voice and monitor external affairs that may impact our operations, reputation or performance.

We deliver safety, warmth, and comfort to homes and businesses. Every role, whether in the office or on the front line, plays a key part in this mission. Here's how you will contribute
- Supporting political engagement - You will support the Senior External Affairs Manager with their engagement in Holyrood and the Scottish Government. Supporting the delivery of meetings with Scottish Ministers and their officials, engaging with MSPs across all parties, ensuring follow-up actions are delivered.
- Leading Logistics & Events - Supporting the Senior External Affairs Manager in planning and delivering SGN presence at Scottish Party Conferences and other key industry events.
- Strategic Stakeholder Mapping - Develop and maintain engagement plans including Scottish think tanks, NGOs and Scottish Government officials to help shape the energy policy environment.
- Intelligence and Monitoring - Monitoring parliamentary activity including the Official Report, committee inquiries, motions, written questions and consultations. You will produce updates for internal SGN audiences and support the Senior External Affairs Manager with consultation responses.
- Building Brand Profile - You will have opportunities to lead on our meetings with backbench MSPs and parliamentary researchers to build our profile, while supporting the Executive team with high-quality briefing materials for senior engagements.
- Campaign Support - Working closely with the Senior External Affairs Manager, you'll help develop and execute impactful public affairs campaigns that protect and enhance our corporate reputation.

What you will need
- Approximately 2-4 years of experience within a political office (MSP/MP office), in-house team, or agency, with a solid grasp of Scottish parliamentary procedures and the legislative cycle.
- A working understanding of how the Scottish Government operates, including how decisions are made.
- An existing contact base or the confidence to build one quickly among parliamentary researchers, office managers, and Scottish Government stakeholder teams.
- You can translate complex policy debates and political terminology into clear, concise communications for internal audiences.
- Previous experience managing political logistics and events in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail is non-negotiable.
- A genuine interest in energy, infrastructure, or climate change policy (familiarity with key Scottish Government departments relevant to energy, resilience, and skills is a distinct advantage).
- You are a proactive team player who is comfortable operating independently on day-to-day tasks while supporting the wider organisation's strategic goals.

Not sure you meet every requirement?

Research shows some people - particularly women and those from underrepresented backgrounds - may hesitate to apply unless they meet every criteria. At SGN, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If this role interests you but you're not sure you tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you. You might be just who we're looking for - now or in the future.

Why SGN?

SGN leads pioneering research and development for a energy system. Our innovative technologies are transforming the gas industry while keeping people safe and warm. We are an award-winning employer, including CCA Gold Awards for Great Places to Work and Inclusivity and Accessibility , and a proud Gold member of the Armed Forces Covenant.

If you require any accommodations or support during the application process, reach out to us. We're here to help ensure an inclusive and accessible experience for everyone.

title: Social Media & Office Support Apprentice
description:
LAT_56 is a premium bag and luggage brand creating products for work, travel and everyday life. We are seeking a motivated and creative apprentice who will split their time between LAT_56 and Core Facilities, gaining valuable experience across two growing businesses.

This is an exciting opportunity to work towards a recognised apprenticeship qualification while developing practical skills in marketing, business operations, customer engagement and digital technologies. Working alongside experienced professionals from both companies, you'll contribute to real business projects, learn how different organisations operate, and build the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for a successful career.

Job responsibilities:
- Support the planning, creation and scheduling of digital content across social media channels, including TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn
- Become a competent user of CRM, marketing and business systems, ensuring information is maintained accurately
- Assist with the delivery of digital marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement and customer reach
- Use collaborative technologies such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and other digital platforms to communicate and work effectively with colleagues
- Create basic marketing assets such as social media posts, email content, blogs and promotional materials
- Monitor and report on campaign performance using analytics and marketing tools, identifying opportunities for improvement
- Research market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviours to support marketing decisions and campaign planning
- Contribute creative ideas and support partnerships, customer engagement activities and brand-building initiatives that help achieve business objectives

Required skills:
- Creative mindset
- Ambitious, hardworking and motivated by measurable success
- Confident communicating with people
- Curious and comfortable with social media and digital trends
- Organised, self-directed and eager to learn from experienced colleagues

Working hours: Monday to Thursday 8.30am - 5pm, Friday 8.30am - 4pm

Benefits:
- Coaching and mentoring from experienced marketing professionals.
- Onsite parking
- Pension (if eligible)

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 6.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!
